name: Hasumi Yuto
source:
One of the men that Miona meets through the SNS where he is impersonating someone else.

He is looking for a date on SNS and posts a message.

Contrary to his appearance, he has a calm demeanor and is knowledgeable and intelligent.

He is good with women, and uses words and actions that the other person wants to hear, so he is easy to like and very popular with the ladies.
